patterns.note: Each primary content section (project hero) occupies the full viewport, creating an immersive, scroll-snapping experience that transitions between different projects.
Scrolling triggers a full-screen transition between different project hero videos or images, effectively acting as the primary navigation through the portfolio's main reel.
Extremely minimalist typography, using a single small sans-serif font for all navigation, project titles, and meta information, maintaining a flat hierarchy.
A stark black and white UI palette provides high contrast against the rich, full-bleed media content, ensuring text readability without competing with the visuals.
Project detail pages feature a prominent video player or large image at the top, followed by a grid of smaller supporting images and detailed text credits below.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-page scroll or scroll-snapping mechanism to transition between different full-bleed video or image project heroes. Each hero fills the viewport, creating an immersive, sequential viewing experience, leveraging the 'video-hero' animation tech for dynamic content. Project detail pages then present a standard video player with accompanying text and a grid of image thumbnails.

Navigation and meta-information are presented in a minimalist, fixed overlay, using small, unobtrusive text that maintains readability against varying video backgrounds without distracting from the primary media.

design_tokens.type_scale: minimalist and flat; all text (navigation, project titles, meta info) is consistently small, sans-serif, and lacks prominent headings, emphasizing the visual content.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; content is full-bleed with minimal text elements positioned at the viewport edges, creating a sense of spaciousness around the media.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its immersive, full-screen, scroll-driven video portfolio experience. Instead of a traditional grid or list, the homepage acts as an interactive reel, where each scroll reveals a new project's hero video, making the content itself the primary interface and navigation.
